item.title: Identity Services
item.description:
Layer5 Cloud offers a built-in identity provider (IDP), supporting OIDC for normal users and token-based authentication (access, ID, refresh tokens) for API clients with JSON Web Signature (JWS) for token signing. Layer5 Cloud users can sign-up via email and password in addition to social identity providers (Google and GitHub) via OAuth2. See Getting Started with a Layer5 Account for details.

Layer5 Cloud identity services include features such as account recovery, email verification, automatica social sign-in account linking, and multi-factor authentication (coming soon).

item.title: Organization Configuration Scenarios
item.description:
Every organization in Layer5 Cloud is configured by two choices: where your users sign in (the front door) and whose identity provider authenticates them. The combinations form five named scenarios. This guide helps you pick one and then walks through the settings that implement it, including who is allowed to change each setting.

For the mechanics behind the choices, see White-labeling (themes, logos, custom domains) and Identity Services (bring-your-own-credentials and authentication boundaries).
